snippet.title: Lucky Newt Prototype Level: Expansion Update Preview!
snippet.description:
We are preparing and polishing the Prototype level for MomoCon in Atlanta this year! Here is a list of things that are currently in development for the game:

1) Improvement to Character Movement

2) Add Power-Up system with new moves

3) Expand and Polish Prototype Level

4) Build a 2 Player System and Battle Mode

5) Add 2 enemies and Polish

I am trying so hard every day to make this game better and more fun to play, so please support me by subscribing, liking, and giving us feedback on what we need to improve! Thanks :)

And if you haven't, check out our new comic and enjoy the wacky adventures with Lucky Newt, Amelia Axolotl, and Murphy Mudpuppy as they wield powerful magical charms to stop the ancient salamander general Salazar from conquering their home, Luckypad Lagoon.

Comic: https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/the-small-adventures-of-lucky-newt/list?title_no=1114653
